title: Schedule of Window Changes and Cancellation Charges for Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
## Schedule of window changes and cancellation charges — Cartwise Grocery Orders

The following terms apply to every Cartwise Grocery Orders order according to the service level booked.

| Service level | Reschedule cutoff before the booked window start | Reschedules allowed per order | Cancellation fee once shopping has started | Cancellation after checkout |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | 1 hour | 2 | 5.00 USD | not available |
| No-Rush Delivery | 2 hours | 1 | 5.00 USD | not available |
| Standard Delivery | 1 hour | 2 | 7.50 USD | not available |
| Priority Delivery | 1 hour | 1 | 7.50 USD | not available |
| Express 30 Delivery | 0 hours | 0 | 7.50 USD | not available |
| Stock-Up Delivery | 4 hours | 1 | 15.00 USD | not available |

### Terms of the schedule

1. The **reschedule cutoff** is the number of whole hours before the booked window start that marks the last moment at which the window may be moved.
2. **Reschedules allowed** is the number of moves of the booked window permitted on one order; Express 30 Delivery allows 0.
3. The **cancellation fee** is the fee billed when the customer cancels after shopping has started and before checkout.
4. **Cancellation after checkout** is not available at any Cartwise Grocery Orders service level.

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A hypothetical Stock-Up Delivery order booked for a window starting at 14:00 has its reschedule cutoff 4 hours earlier, at 10:00; the same window at Standard Delivery has its cutoff at 13:00.
- A hypothetical Standard Delivery order already moved twice has used both of its 2 reschedules; a No-Rush Delivery order uses its only reschedule with the first move.
